title: Judge Gift Cards 2015: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Doing something at the last minute isn't so bad when you can make that minute last.
Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war." —Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching*, trans. Feng and English
"It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."
The land was left depleted and empty, an unsettling taste of things to come.
